title: PhlimboV3 promo Flushing-window accPromoPerShare over-credit steals co-stakers' promo tokens (or DoS)
description: During the promo Flushing phase, PhlimboV3 pauses the contract so staker membership and accumulators are frozen while batchClaim aligns each staker's promoDebt to the pre-advance accPromoPerShare. collectReward(uint256) (L559) is external nonReentrant with no onlyOwner and no whenNotPaused guard, so any unprivileged address can call it inside the flush window; it invokes _updatePool (L563) which advances accPromoPerShare (L759) AFTER batchClaim aligned the debts. The gap becomes phantom pending promo that survives finalizePromotion (which retains the accumulator, L481) and applies against the next promotion's token.
impact: Direct theft of honest co-stakers' share of the partner promo-token pool: a claimant with effectively zero stake time collects promo tokens that economically belong to other stakers. Loss is bounded by the active promo pool size, not full TVL. Alternate branch: the double-advance overshoots available balance so honest claims revert with ERC20InsufficientBalance (claim DoS).
attackPath: Owner opens a promo and later runs beginFlush (a normal, recurring promo-lifecycle step) which pauses and sets promoPhase=Flushing.
batchClaim aligns/settles per-staker accPromoPerShare debts for the flush.
Any address permissionlessly calls collectReward, which advances accPromoPerShare again past the aligned debts during the Flushing window.
The attacker or opportunistic staker claims promo tokens in the next accrual with effectively zero stake time, capturing value that should accrue to honest co-stakers.
Alternate branch: the double-advance overshoots available balance so honest claims revert with ERC20InsufficientBalance (claim DoS).
recommendation: Guard collectReward with whenNotPaused (or otherwise block accumulator advance during Flushing), so accPromoPerShare cannot move after batchClaim has aligned promoDebt.

poc.note: theft + DoS branches; invariant INV-PROMO-01 broke 14 runs/840 calls and 30 runs/1800 calls

distinctnessNote: DISTINCT from the acknowledged V1 Linear-Depletion (ledger M-04) and its rate-recompute mitigation. This is an accumulator-advance-during-flush defect on a V3-only promo feature; must NOT be collapsed into M-04 in any future run.
priorArtCrossRef: ledger M-04 (V1 Linear-Depletion, acknowledged) — same family, distinct sub-bug
